scenes.say: The champion is already decided, but five drivers are fighting for second. Thirty-three points cover all of them.
Verstappen leads that group on two hundred seventy-nine. Then Russell, Hamilton, Leclerc and Norris.
One single point splits Russell and Hamilton. The old Mercedes team-mates are side by side again.
Every one of the five has won a race this season. Norris was the latest, in São Paulo.
Verstappen has finished top three seven years running. An eighth would equal Hamilton's record.
Three races left and no sprints. That's seventy-five points at most, so nobody is out of it.
Watch the standings change during the race on LapRadar.

title: Five drivers, 33 points: who finishes second in F1 2026
